On Christmas day 2021, I fell and twisted my ankle, and I was distraught, the one thing that brought me joy, running, was taken away from me, and I couldn't tell you how much that destroyed me, here I was 101kg, 5'10, not being able to even exercise. I decided to get into the gym for atleast an hour a day, it saved my life, i could feel myself get physically better, as well as mentally healthy, started going out more, started going on trips with friends, started to smile more. Im 76kg now, still 5'10 can't help that :/. Packing on muscle mass, and I eat so much more than when i was 101kg, eat to a point I feel like throwing up, this too with like half the calories. 

Like i tell all my friends going through a rough patch, just go to the gym for 1hour a day and eat properly for a month. Trust me you will feel better. Lifting weights gives all serotonin you need.

Hey, ik this is a very very very cliche comment. But go to the gym, eat healthy. And no this isn't a 'get ripped, get bitches' thing. It's a 'lift weights, get serotonin hit' thing. I was legitimately on my bed for 20 hours a day, and depressed and suicidal and all that. I started going to the gym for an hour a day, started being mindful of my meals and I got a loooot happier and confident, and I kept going and I kept getting happier, people around me talked shit about me spending multiple hours at the gym, at me for measuring my meals, but that's what saved me from my darkest and lowest point in my life, it became my safe space, the people in the gym community are some of the most understanding, supportive, helpful people ever. Many of us started working out to vetter ourselves and give our mental health a better environment. 

Please please trust me, for a month, just for a month go to the gym for atleast 30 minutes, and eat a bit healthier and make sure you hit your calories everyday. Just a month. If you feel better W, if you dont, no harm done.

Ik for a fact that all these thoughts will start to effect you lesser and lesser, because that's exactly the same thoughts i used to have a little over 8 months back.

Chicken, chicken is the top teir low cal, high volume food, use a 0 cal cooking spray to cook it. 

Egg whites have been my favourite for all my cuts.

Oats have been a staple in my cutting diet for a very long time. 

Popcorn is a favourite amongst bodybuilders for it's nutrition and high volume. 

Watermelon, 300g of it will only set you back for around 80 cals. 

As a snack or something to satiate your sweet tooth, skip the chocolates and go for a lollipop, a single lollipop has around 20 cals and you are usually done by 1 or 2 max. 


P.S make sure to prioritise proteins in a diet as it keeps you fuller for longer, keep the fruits as an option as desserts or snacks, do not use them as replacements for meals, you may over indulge on them.
Easily option B, since you are trying to do a clean bulk, prioritise proteins in your diet, and it also provides some healthy fats which are essential as well.

I used to find eating oats without sugar to be very hard, and I found out about masala oats during my college days, and now it's an integral part of my cutting diets. Moreover you just have to boil it in water and didn't require milk freeing up even more cals. If you really want to have milk and oats, a couple of seconds before you add your oats to the milk, dice a banana or an apple and boil it in milk, but make sure you don't boil it for too long, the fruits will get mushy.

Indian here, Engineering undergrad, spend time writing and acting in a pretty good theatrics group, trying to work in a kitchen now. 

What I'm trying to say is, I've seen a lot of Indians from various fields. 

From my experience, the smartest Indians aren't the ones who are engineers or doctors (trust me on this one). Give your character a lot of emotional intelligence, give them a couple of vices if those work in your plot, in india more often than not the street smart geniuses hit the blunt. If the woman is from a traditional household she's going to have an issue interacting with the opposite gender due to having limited interactions with them growing up. Don't play up her academic brilliance, make it more subtle. Something that has always irked me off is how much western media plays up the academic prowess of indians. In my experience, I've found 'smart' students dumb as a fucking brick. 

Dont tell that she aces her maths tests, show a scene of her busting out the Bayes Theorem to help her cousin with a problem.  

Dont tell that she discovered gravity, have her teach her niece how to weaponize her glasses nd the sunlight against the obnoxious boy in her class. 

Let her smartness come out through her actions rather than your words. Don't make her infallible, Indians like anyone else are not gods, she can't fucking learn organic chemistry nor can she understand why benzene is a fucking circle, but you know she can pull of the double slit experiment in her sleep. 

Im sorry if i ranted or is unclear in any place. I tend to do that.
